'''Lobax Resuun''' was the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Governor Resuun was in charge of his sector when chaos erupted in the Tamarin sector following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Challenged by fledgling planetary governments, Governor Resuun was also forced to struggle against the demoralization of the remaining [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and the expending criminality. Organized crime had grown to a powerful economizing military force throughout the sector. The governor's headquarters and the sectorial government were eventually relocated to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Retribution (Imperial-class)|''Retribution'']].

Undaunted, Governor Resuun managed to maintained enough power and influence to avoid any open revolution against the Empire until the actions of [[Sard Nightbringer]], the most powerful [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] of the sector. She was determined to force the Empire out of the sector and take over the government. Nightbringer managed to invade the [[Imperial Research and Development Station T-1583]] and steal experimental technology. Resuun hired a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to infiltrate her organization but she was eventually killed by [[Marg Sonat|her second]].
